title: Hidden Word
statement: Return true if the letters of word appear in text in the same order (not necessarily next to each other), otherwise false.

answerKey.pattern: Two pointers, one in each string
keyPoints: i points into word, j walks through text
When text[j] equals word[i], move i forward
Return true if i reaches the end of word
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Search for each letter from the start of the text again: O(n * m)

hints: The order matters. What do you need to remember about your progress in word?
Keep one pointer in word and one in text.
Move the word pointer only on a match; the text pointer always moves.
